calls.video_title: Why Is Sea Limited Stock Falling, and is it a Buying Opportunity? SE Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: Just below $75 (stated); near 52-week low, was over $130 in August
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked Parkevtate SE call. Undervalued on both forward P/E (14.83 vs 18.6% expected EPS growth) and DCF ($104 vs ~$75); balance sheet strong with $11.5bn cash vs $2.7bn debt.
calls.base_case: Total revenue +48% last quarter; Shopee GMV +28%, loan book +62%; gaming (most profitable segment) growing slowest at 15%.
calls.bull_case: Cash flow from operations/sales 18.8% funds growth ambitions; asset-light e-commerce expansion.
calls.bear_case: Costs rising sharply; concern lending standards are being relaxed too aggressively; macro headwinds and non-US risk; may take over a year to recalibrate expenses.

calls.video_title: 4 Stocks You’ll Wish You Bought Before Earnings
calls.price_at_call: $54.7B market cap (stated); no share price stated
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked Couch SE call, no flip: one of four fairly cheap names to buy before earnings; oversold, down 31% YTD / ~36.5% drawdown, at the same price as two quarters ago, forward P/E 21.1x and price/FCF 12x forward despite ~35-40% revenue growth.
calls.base_case: Still a growth company run much better than 3-4 years ago, beating revenue/EBITDA expectations comfortably (last two quarters ~10% beats) even as EPS misses persist.
calls.bull_case: Growth holds at ~30%+ near term (revenue to ~$45B by FY28) and Shopee keeps gaining share against Mercado Libre, Alibaba, Amazon and Pinduoduo; a possible Garena ('Coney' in captions) spin-off surfaces value.
calls.bear_case: Free cash flow is not expected to grow much as Garena grows, EPS keeps missing, and competition stays intense in Southeast Asia, South America and Taiwan.
